This Quarto notebook is the canonical executable source for
`scripts/build_16s_candidate_figures.qmd`. It renders editable one-page vector
PDFs under the repository visual grammar in `R/figure_style.R`: control is
`#8FCB8A`, phage-UV is `#7E57C2`, phase is a shape, cycle is a line type, and
the two remainder categories keep their fixed greys.

Filenames are deliberately unnumbered. Figure numbers are allocated by the
manuscript stream under issue #30, not by this workstream.

```sh
bash scripts/run_qmd.sh scripts/build_16s_candidate_figures.qmd [ecology_dir] [output_dir]
```

Automatic execution during rendering is disabled because this workflow writes
project outputs.

```{r}
#| label: build-16s-candidate-figures
#| echo: true
abort <- function(...) stop(sprintf(...), call. = FALSE)

args <- commandArgs(trailingOnly = TRUE)
ecology_dir <- if (length(args) >= 1L) args[[1L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_ECOLOGY_DIR")
output_dir <- if (length(args) >= 2L) args[[2L]] else Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_16S_FIGURE_DIR")
if (!nzchar(ecology_dir) || !nzchar(output_dir)) {
  abort("Provide ecology_dir and output_dir, or source config/16s_analysis_paths.sh first.")
}
if (!requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) abort("Package ggplot2 is required.")
notebook <- Sys.getenv("PHAGE_UV_NOTEBOOK_PATH", unset = "")
repo_root <- if (nzchar(notebook)) dirname(dirname(notebook)) else getwd()
source(file.path(repo_root, "R", "figure_style.R"))
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

read_tsv <- function(path) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) abort("Missing %s. Run scripts/analyse_16s_community_ecology.qmd first.", path)
  read.delim(path, sep = "\t", header = TRUE, quote = "", comment.char = "",
             check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

composition <- read_tsv(file.path(ecology_dir, "16s_family_profile_long.tsv"))
alpha <- read_tsv(file.path(ecology_dir, "16s_alpha_diversity.tsv"))
ordination <- read_tsv(file.path(ecology_dir, "16s_beta_ordination_coordinates.tsv"))

condition_labels <- c(control = "Control", treatment = "Phage-UV")
normalise <- function(x) phage_uv_normalise_condition(x)
cycle_phase_levels <- c("c1_initial", "c1_backflush", "c2_initial", "c2_backflush",
                        "c3_initial", "c3_backflush")
cycle_phase_labels <- c("C1\ninitial", "C1\nbackflush", "C2\ninitial",
                        "C2\nbackflush", "C3\ninitial", "C3\nbackflush")

# ---------------------------------------------------- family community profile
remainder <- c("Other classified families", "Unclassified at family level")
families <- setdiff(unique(composition$family), remainder)
extra_palette <- c(
  "#4E79A7", "#F28E2B", "#E15759", "#76B7B2", "#59A14F", "#EDC948", "#B07AA1",
  "#FF9DA7", "#9C755F", "#17BECF", "#1B9E77", "#D95F02", "#7570B3", "#E7298A",
  "#66A61E", "#A6761D", "#8DA0CB", "#E78AC3", "#A6D854", "#FFD92F", "#BC80BD",
  "#80B1D3", "#FB8072", "#B3DE69", "#FCCDE5"
)
family_colours <- stats::setNames(rep(extra_palette, length.out = length(families)), families)
fixed <- intersect(families, names(phage_uv_family_colours))
family_colours[fixed] <- phage_uv_family_colours[fixed]
family_colours[remainder] <- phage_uv_family_colours[remainder]

composition$condition <- normalise(composition$condition)
composition$cycle_phase <- factor(composition$cycle_phase, levels = cycle_phase_levels)
composition$family <- factor(composition$family, levels = c(families, remainder))

composition_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  composition,
  ggplot2::aes(x = cycle_phase, y = relative_abundance, fill = family)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~condition, ncol = 1,
                      labeller = ggplot2::labeller(condition = condition_labels)) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = family_colours, name = "Family") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = cycle_phase_labels) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(100 * x, "%"), expand = c(0, 0)) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance of 16S reads") +
  theme_phage_uv() +
  ggplot2::theme(legend.position = "right",
                 legend.text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 6),
                 legend.key.size = grid::unit(0.32, "cm"))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ ordination
ordination$condition <- normalise(ordination$condition)
ordination$phase <- factor(ordination$phase, levels = c("initial", "backflush"))
ordination$cycle <- factor(ordination$cycle, levels = c("1", "2", "3"))
axis_label <- function(data, axis) {
  percent <- unique(data[[paste0(axis, "_percent_variance")]])[1]
  sprintf("Axis %s (%.1f%% of variation)", sub("^axis", "", axis), percent)
}
ordination_panels <- lapply(split(ordination, ordination$metric), function(sub) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(sub, ggplot2::aes(x = axis1, y = axis2)) +
    ggplot2::geom_path(ggplot2::aes(group = condition, colour = condition),
                       linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(colour = condition, shape = phase), size = 2.6) +
    ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = cycle), size = 2.1, colour = "#222222",
                       nudge_y = diff(range(sub$axis2)) * 0.05) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = phage_uv_condition_colours,
                                 labels = condition_labels, name = "Membrane") +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = phage_uv_phase_shapes, name = "Phase") +
    ggplot2::labs(x = axis_label(sub, "axis1"), y = axis_label(sub, "axis2"),
                  subtitle = sub("_", " ", unique(sub$metric))) +
    theme_phage_uv()
})

# -------------------------------------------------------------- alpha diversity
alpha$condition <- normalise(alpha$condition)
alpha$cycle_phase <- factor(alpha$cycle_phase, levels = cycle_phase_levels)
alpha$phase <- factor(alpha$phase, levels = c("initial", "backflush"))
alpha_long <- do.call(rbind, lapply(c("observed_asvs", "shannon", "pielou_evenness"), function(metric) {
  data.frame(
    cycle_phase = alpha$cycle_phase, condition = alpha$condition, phase = alpha$phase,
    metric = factor(metric, levels = c("observed_asvs", "shannon", "pielou_evenness")),
    value = alpha[[metric]], stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
metric_labels <- c(observed_asvs = "Observed ASVs", shannon = "Shannon",
                   pielou_evenness = "Pielou evenness")
alpha_plot <- ggplot2::ggplot(alpha_long,
                              ggplot2::aes(x = cycle_phase, y = value,
                                           colour = condition, group = condition)) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.4) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(shape = phase), size = 2.4) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1,
                      labeller = ggplot2::labeller(metric = metric_labels)) +
  ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = phage_uv_condition_colours,
                               labels = condition_labels, name = "Membrane") +
  ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = phage_uv_phase_shapes, name = "Phase") +
  ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(labels = cycle_phase_labels) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_phage_uv()

figures <- list(
  "16s-community-composition.pdf" = list(plot = composition_plot, width = 7.2, height = 5.4),
  "16s-alpha-diversity.pdf" = list(plot = alpha_plot, width = 5.2, height = 6.0)
)
for (index in seq_along(ordination_panels)) {
  name <- sprintf("16s-community-ordination-%s.pdf", names(ordination_panels)[index])
  figures[[name]] <- list(plot = ordination_panels[[index]], width = 5.2, height = 4.4)
}

registry <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(figures), function(name) {
  spec <- figures[[name]]
  path <- file.path(output_dir, name)
  grDevices::pdf(path, width = spec$width, height = spec$height, useDingbats = FALSE)
  print(spec$plot)
  invisible(grDevices::dev.off())
  data.frame(
    figure_file = name,
    width_inches = spec$width,
    height_inches = spec$height,
    md5 = unname(tools::md5sum(path)),
    allocation = "unallocated_candidate",
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
write.table(registry, file.path(output_dir, "16s_figure_candidate_registry.tsv"),
            sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

print(registry)
cat(sprintf("\nWrote candidate figures to %s\n", output_dir))
cat("Do not assign main or supplementary figure numbers here; that is issue #30's decision.\n")
```
